title: How do I set the number of worker threads?

posts.author: sam_ops
posts.body: New to Corvex. What's the config setting to control how many jobs a worker runs at once? Running 1.7.

posts.author: l_turner
posts.body:
It's the top-level `worker_threads` key in corvex.yaml:

```yaml
redis_url: redis://localhost:6379/0
worker_threads: 12
http_port: 9000
```

Defaults to 4 if you don't set it.

posts.author: gwen_h
posts.body: Heads up for anyone finding this later: on Corvex 2.x this answer is out of date. `worker_threads` was renamed to `workers.concurrency` (nested) in 2.0, `redis_url` became `storage.redis.url`, and `http_port` became `http.addr`. A 1.x config like the one above throws CVX-1002 on 2.x. The default also changed from 4 to 'number of CPU cores'.
